rules.title: Macro-enabled Office attachment delivered to a mailbox
rules.detection: mail.attachment.extension IN (docm, xlsm, pptm) AND mail.verdict != "quarantined"
rules.description: Macro-enabled Office attachment delivered to a mailbox — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Office application spawning PowerShell
rules.description: Office application spawning PowerShell — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: MFA push fatigue — repeated denials followed by an approval
rules.detection: count(mfa.result = "denied") >= 5 within 10m by user FOLLOWED BY mfa.result = "approved" within 15m
rules.description: MFA push fatigue — repeated denials followed by an approval — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Privileged sign-in from an unusual geography
rules.detection: signin.user IN privileged_accounts AND geo.country NOT IN user.baseline_countries
rules.description: Privileged sign-in from an unusual geography — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: RDP from a clinic workstation to the server segment
rules.description: RDP from a clinic workstation to the server segment — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Bulk patient-record query by a service account
rules.detection: ehr.audit.records_read by account > 10 x 30-day baseline within 1h AND account.type = "service"
rules.description: Bulk patient-record query by a service account — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Deletion of shadow copies or backup catalogue
rules.detection:
selection_vss:
  Image|endswith: \vssadmin.exe
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - delete
    - shadows
selection_catalog:
  EventSource: backup
  Action: catalog_delete
condition: 1 of selection_*
rules.description: Deletion of shadow copies or backup catalogue — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Mass file encryption or rename on file shares
rules.detection:
selection:
  EventType: rename
  TargetFilename|re: '\.[a-z0-9]{5,8}$'
timeframe: 2m
condition: selection | count() by Computer > 200
rules.description: Mass file encryption or rename on file shares — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Large download from the cloud image-transfer storage by an unknown address
rules.detection: cloud.storage.bytes_out > 5 GB within 1h AND src.ip NOT IN partner_ranges
rules.description: Large download from the cloud image-transfer storage by an unknown address — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: DNS query or connection matching a threat indicator
rules.detection: dns.query IN indicators.domain OR net.dst_ip IN indicators.ipv4
rules.description: DNS query or connection matching a threat indicator — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Rogue access point broadcasting a MediBec SSID
rules.description: Rogue access point broadcasting a MediBec SSID — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Help-desk MFA reset followed by a sign-in from a new device
rules.detection: idp.mfa_reset by helpdesk FOLLOWED BY signin from new_device within 2h
rules.description: Help-desk MFA reset followed by a sign-in from a new device — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.

rules.title: Password spraying against administrative interfaces
rules.detection: count(distinct user) > 20 with auth.result = failure from one src.ip within 10m
rules.description: Password spraying against administrative interfaces — FICTIONAL — simulation data for the MediBec teaching case.
